She has released two studio albums: Messy (2023) and The Art of Loving (2025), as well as two live albums and four EPs. In 2021, Dean was named the breakthrough artist of the year by Amazon Music, and in 2023, she was selected as BBC Music Introducing Artist of the Year. She made her SNL musical guest debut on Saturday Night Live on November 15, 2025, which is the 6th episode of Season 51, hosted by Glen Powell. Gallery[] Season 51 of Saturday Night Live Bumper Photo from November 15, 2025, the sixth episode of Season 51 of Saturday Night Live, hosted by actor Glen Powell: The musical guest debut on SNL for Olivia Dean.
